name: android-android-intent-security
description: Audits, detects, and remediates Android Intent and component security vulnerabilities. Use this skill when auditing component configurations in AndroidManifest.xml (activities, services, receivers) or source code handling incoming Intents (getIntent, getParcelableExtra) to prevent Intent Redirection and unauthorized access. Don't use for network security, TLS configuration, or general runtime permission request flows.
